authorization: User2026-10-16 adopted execution of the single attenuated correction on opened July/August Owasco; MAE primary, no regression change or September.

model.meaning: Bind exactsavedmodel metadata only; never callfit or recomputeR.

rule.R: Exact saved same-frozen-ridge-without-fallback; never refit or recompute R
rule.oldF: Exact saved small-correction-filter at abs(R-P)>0.100; unchanged comparator
rule.otherwise: magnitude=abs(c)-0.100; attenuatedCorrection=magnitude if c>0 else -magnitude; Q=P+attenuatedCorrection
rule.operationOrder: Strict binary64 subtract R-P, compare abs(c)<=0.1; otherwise subtract threshold, apply sign, then add P. No algebraic reorder, decimal quantization, clipping, epsilon or future target input.
rule.meaning: Single soft-threshold postprocessor; same gate-active origins as oldF, smaller correction magnitude, not a new count reduction over oldF
rule.parameterMeaning: 0.100 inherited from previous development filter; not sensor accuracy, ecological threshold or independently selected after seeing Q scores. No parameter scan.
rule.gateActiveDefinition: finite c and abs(c)>0.1, independent of target
rule.changedPredictionDefinition: finite Q and Q!=P; distinguish representability degeneracies from gate-active count

continuation.primaryMetric: MAE over the full unchanged accepted monthly cohort
continuation.invalidComputedPolicy: Nonfinite R/c/Q or Q<0 prevents success; record on full eligible cohort with null uncomputable errors; no row deletion or silent P rescue. Finite negative R/F remains a flagged numeric comparator; does not alone invalidate nonnegative Q.
continuation.sourceIntegrityPolicy: Broken source hash, timestamps, station, feature order, missing or inconsistent source history/P/actual stops execution; never drop, interpolate or repair those rows.
continuation.ifNotMet: STOP_Q_AND_DISCUSS; no automatic variant, threshold scan, substitute window, September or model change
continuation.meaning: Development screen adopted before first Q score, not statistical significance or ecological usefulness

originGroups: fixed abs(c) bins from previous protocol
reporting.outcomeGroups: Q vs oldF improves/ties/worsens AFTER routing; show Q-P gain on same groups, not a forecast trigger
reporting.rowEvidence: Every source row index, origin/target, exact P/R/F/Q,c,attenuatedc,actual,errors,gains and validity; source hashes bind exact shared history/features. Complete original history/features for every gate-active case.
reporting.examples: First chronological QImprovesP,QWorsensP,attenuationImprovesOldF,attenuationWorsensOldF; null if empty; selected post-hoc only for explanation
reporting.recomposition: Verify monthly P/R/F reconstruct original scores; group counts/sums reconstruct all-cohort N/errors/gains; Q gain vs oldF equals error reductions on gate-active rows
reporting.timeOccupancy: UTC days and24/48/72hour blocks anchored sourcewindow start; descriptive only, not independence or inference

integrity.clockToleranceMeaning: Only sourcefeature sin/cos integrity across mathlibraries; not applied to d,c,routing or bins.
integrity.history: Exactly12finite nonnegativeoxygenvaluesat30min endingorigin; feature0/1/2/3 exactlymatchpastoxygen; sourcefeature6/7finite, temperaturehistory not independently reconstructed here.
integrity.cohort: No interpolation, row deletion, originshifts, targetbasedselection or neweligibility; Nmustmatchsavedboundcohorts.

freezeOrder: Commit/push exact protocol+diagnostic+synthetic tests before first Q environmental score; exclusive first output, subsequent no-write replay
scope: Retrospective development on opened July/August2020 USGS Owasco with unchanged2024 Willamette R. Previous results preserved, no new or blind validation.
prohibited: Operational Oracle, blockchain, consensus, governance or funding changes
mission: Understandable verifiable environmental evidence serving communities; numerical research only, LLM outside operational consensus.
